sections.text: Dismantle the domed cover 03 including burner and swirl.

The crane cables are attached to the three support hooks 06 and the basket 
 07 is lowered into the combustion chamber

Inspect the combustion chamber tiles (finned segments) if it is not good ( 
 it have a big wear ) it must by changed.
To change the combustion chamber tiles ( finned segments ) see fig. 2.

Remove all six plates 01 on the swirl guide 02, do not dismantle swirl 
 guide.
Disassemble the tow upper sight glass connection tubes 04.

السلة 07 متصلة بالرافعة العلوية ويتم إنزالها في 
 غرفة الاحتراق حتى تصبح الحلقة العلوية للسلة أقل قليلاً 
 حامل الجزء ذو الزعانف 05 والذي سيتم رفعه واستبداله 
 بلاطة سيئة (الجزء ذو الزعانف السيئة)

After changing the bad tile install finned segment carrier 05 in its 
 position.
Install the two upper sight glass connection tube 04.
Install all six plates 01on the swirl guide 02.
Install the domed cover 03 including burner and swirl.
